Michael "Dr. Mike" Katz

Republican candidate for U.S. Senator, Delaware · Challenger

Pediatric critical care anesthesiologist and commercial real estate business owner

Michael "Dr. Mike" Katz is a physician, business owner and former Delaware state senator who served as a Democrat. He ran for U.S. Senate in 2024 as the Independent Party of Delaware candidate and finished third. He won the September 15, 2026 Republican primary over John Shulli and faces incumbent Democratic Sen. Chris Coons in the November 3, 2026 general election.

Where Katz stands

Federal spending and inflation
Says federal spending drives inflation. Pledges to work with President Trump to stop wasteful federal spending and to require accountability in the federal budget.
Taxes
Opposes raising taxes on working families. Supports making pro-growth tax cuts permanent and cutting back federal regulation.
Energy
Supports a diversified energy strategy that includes nuclear power, and backs the ADVANCE Act on permitting and advanced nuclear technology. Says federal decisions on offshore wind and the grid should not raise Delaware families' costs.
Housing
Proposes removing federal barriers to home construction and creating tax incentives, lending standards and construction support for first-time homebuyers. Also proposes zoning reform partnerships to add affordable housing.
Health care
Supports prescription drug pricing reform that protects innovation, more rural health funding for Kent and Sussex counties, lower insurance premiums, and making mental health part of primary care.
Military and veterans
Supports fully funding military readiness and modernizing the armed forces. Also supports protecting veterans' benefits, reducing VA disability claim backlogs and expanding telehealth for rural veterans.
Campaign priorities
Says his focus in the Senate would be lowering the cost of living, fixing the health care system and making the federal government more fiscally responsible.

Background

  • Pediatric critical care anesthesiologist; has also managed surgical facilities and advised health systems
  • Owner of a commercial real estate company
  • Former Delaware state senator who served as a Democrat; sat on the Small Business, Banking, Education and Energy/Transportation committees (campaign cites 2012)
  • 2024 U.S. Senate candidate for the Independent Party of Delaware; finished third with about 4% of the vote
  • 2026 Republican nominee for U.S. Senate; won the Sept. 15, 2026 primary over John Shulli
